title: Arabic typography verified on local web app
summary: Verified clearer Arabic fonts, larger controls and revised home wording in mobile and desktop web layouts.

changes.detail: Added a repeatable browser check for font loading, text direction, responsive wrapping, journey expansion and tutor navigation.
Verified Noto Arabic Regular and SemiBold render as actual custom fonts instead of falling back. Reviewed Arabic screenshots at 320px and 390px in light and dark themes.

validation.name: TypeScript
validation.detail: npm run typecheck completed without errors.

validation.name: Focused source lint
validation.detail: ESLint passed for the six modified TypeScript/TSX source files.

validation.name: Change History
validation.detail: Manifest check passed with all 354 reports preserved before this verification entry; all six archive and interaction tests passed.

validation.name: Responsive browser verification
validation.detail: 24 combinations: Arabic, English, French; light/dark; 320, 390, 768, 1280px. No horizontal page overflow or page errors. Verified heading direction/wrapping, five tabs, Arabic font loading, journey expansion/collapse and tutor navigation. A first test used an unsupported aria-expanded attribute; corrected the test to verify visible journey options, then reran successfully.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Used disposable Edge sessions with synthetic API authentication. Physical Android/iOS devices, real login and production deployment were not tested.
